headline: Return of the Jedi inspires rare toy trike
post:
Remember the thrilling Speeder bike chase from Return of the Jedi? Heritage Auctions has listed an extremely rare 1984 Huffy and Kenner promotional trike designed to look just like the Imperial vehicle. Created as a sweepstakes prize and store display, this unique toddler's ride is exceptionally hard to find today.

While it won't fit neatly on a typical display shelf, it is a fascinating piece of merchandise history for dedicated collectors. 🏍️

Which is your favorite Star Wars land vehicle?

#StarWars #ReturnOfTheJedi #Collectibles
original_title: Return of the Jedi Inspired One of Star Wars’ Rarest Toys, & You’ve Probably Never Heard

headline: Clayface powers and the new DCU
post:
The new DCU movie Clayface is out now, and according to Screen Rant, it sets up a formidable new threat for the live-action future of Batman's corner of the franchise. Matt Hagen gets an updated technological origin story involving nanobots. This grants him a healing factor before his molecular makeup is forever changed by an overdose. The shape-shifting villain can alter his face, craft clothes out of his own skin, and turn his body into any object. 🎭

While the Dark Knight does not appear in the film, Hagen grows increasingly powerful and unstable throughout the story. He ultimately transforms into the towering monster form known from the comics. This leaves the villain in a place where he is filled with rage and his powers are fully established, potentially putting him on a collision path with Batman in future projects.

Do you want to see Batman fight this version of Clayface on the big screen?

#Clayface #DCU #Batman
original_title: How Powerful Clayface Is Compared To Batman & Who'd Win In A DCU Fight

headline: Mr. Terrific to surpass Batman in DC
post:
Batman usually takes the crown for his incredible intellect, but a massive shake-up is on the horizon. According to Screen Rant, Michael Holt is set to officially become the smartest DC superhero in January’s Justice League Unlimited #27. 

This massive change happens after he absorbs all the powers from the Justice League power bank on Dronnda. The issue solicitation teases that “his amplified genius is about to span the cosmos as he prepares to ascend to godhood.” Artwork for the upcoming issue also shows The Atom standing on Mr. Terrific’s shoulder while he sits on a throne. 

However, this new path comes with major concerns. The solicitation mentions that “only the Justice League can hold him back!” Meanwhile, The Atom remains convinced that his teammates are being manipulated by Darkseid. Could this dangerous combination of enhanced intelligence and paranoia spell doom for the DC Universe? 🧠⚡

Are you reading Justice League Unlimited?

#DCComics #MrTerrific #Batman
original_title: DC Declares Its New Smartest Hero, Surpassing Batman By Miles
